about: How much of the Claude Max plan each week used: the one input the repository cannot measure. Write usage_percent by hand at the end of each week (Sunday), from the plan's usage page. A week whose usage ran out before its work sets the next week's capacity. scripts/plan-actuals.mjs shows these weeks on the wiki's Plan versus actual page, beside what each week proved (spec §41, plan_rebaselined).

weeks.note: First week on record: usage was not written down.
